prerequisite: candidate21 CENSORING_RETRIEVAL_PILOT_ALLOWED, unchanged first64 head-held-out train scenes
question: Can cross-view evidence prefer an NMS-censored candidate to its same-view suppressor, selecting actual additional targets rather than duplicate boxes?
budget: Reuse candidate21 cached pools only. Zero detector forwards, zero fitting, zero official evaluation. One fixed rule, no threshold or count sweep.
cache_boundary: Pools have already undergone shared diagnostic GT-ignore filtering in candidate21. All ranking and candidate decisions below read only these cached predictions, not object labels. This is a diagnostic precision screen, not a complete annotation-free deployment audit.
residual: Dense native score>=0.05, exact (view,row) absent from uncapped NMS, same-view higher-score kept box at IoU>0.7, and maximum same-class IoU to baseline confidence>=0.25 strictly below0.7.
suppressor: Highest-native-score same-class kept box from the source view at IoU>0.7. This is an observable suppression witness, not a claimed reconstruction of torchvision internal pair order.
evidence: Other-view dense argmax candidates with native score>=0.05, same class and IoU>=0.5. Ordinary agreement ranks by candidate_score * max(peer_score * peer_iou). Contrast requires peer_iou(candidate)-peer_iou(suppressor)>=0.10 and uses candidate_score * max(peer_score * that_difference).
selection: Select at most4 perimage greedily in descending contrast score; reject a further selected candidate at same-class IoU>=0.7. No qualifying contrast means no additions. Each accepted addition gets score exactly0.25; baseline scores/classes/coordinates preserved. Merge and stable sort, retain at most500 total. Binary score promotion is an intervention whose FP cost must be counted.

controls.native_rank: Same residual candidates, select by native score, same perimage addition count requested by contrast
controls.ordinary_agreement: Same residual candidates, select by ordinary cross-view agreement, same count requested by contrast
controls.uncapped_native_rank: Same count requested by contrast from uncapped NMS residuals, native score ranking; may supply fewer if pool lacks residuals
controls.ordinary_dense_softnms: All cached preNMS predictions merged using unchanged Gaussian Soft-NMS sigma0.5 and max500, native scores; no special resurrection. Scores>=0.25 evaluated. Inventory floor0.05 cannot remove predictions evaluated at0.25 because Soft-NMS only decreases scores.

evaluation: After every arm is fully constructed, greedy class-aware one-to-one matching over all GT and detections at confidence0.25 and IoU0.5. Report all/tiny/small_all recall, FPPI, changed matches, addition TP/duplicate/other FP, and secondary ten-IoU-threshold average recall. No AP claim.
pass_action: Register separately a small fitting/scene-holdout learnability pilot and replay without ignore filtering before any official AP audit. A passing heuristic is not yet an innovation; CLOCs, Soft-NMS and learned suppression are prior art.
fail_action: Stop this fixed suppressor-contrast retrieval rule. Do not change confidence, IoU, contrast gap, addition count or primary metric on this cache to rescue it.
limits: Detector has trained on these scenes; head holdout is not new detector generalization. Only64 repeatedly examined images, proxy metrics, and no independent final confirmation. Missing NMS evidence is a limited problem, not an explanation for all small-object misses.
